title: Original Application before the National Green Tribunal under Sections 14, 15 and 18 of the National Green Tribunal Act, 2010
whenToUse: Use when an individual, resident welfare association, or environmental NGO files an original application before the NGT for substantial environmental damage, illegal industrial discharge, or forest degradation.
variantComparisonNote: Originating application before National Green Tribunal. Distinct from pre-litigation pollution board notice.
youWillNeed: Photographic evidence of environmental degradation, water/soil sample test reports, RTI responses, maps of ecological site, Section 63 BSA certificate.
legalBasis: Sections 14, 15, 18 National Green Tribunal Act, 2010; Water Act, 1974; Air Act, 1981; Environment (Protection) Act, 1986; Precautionary & Polluter Pays Principles.
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Substantial question relating to environment arising out of scheduled enactments
Application filed within 6 months of cause of action first arising under Section 14(3)
Invocation of Precautionary Principle and Polluter Pays Principle under Section 20
Specific prayer for environmental restitution and compensation under Section 15

particulars.label: NGT Bench Name
particulars.description: Principal Bench New Delhi or Zonal Bench

particulars.label: Applicant Name
particulars.description: Full name of aggrieved applicant / citizen

aiBlocks.title: Substantial Question & Locus Standi
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Establish Applicant's locus standi as affected resident, proximity to ecological damage, and substantial question relating to environment under Section 14.

aiBlocks.title: Violations of Environmental Statutes & Damage
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Narrate untreated discharge of toxic effluents/emissions by {{FACT:polluting_entity_respondent}}, breach of CTO norms, and inaction by {{FACT:state_pollution_board}}.

aiBlocks.title: Prayers for Remediation & Environmental Compensation
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft prayers for immediate restraining orders, constitution of joint expert committee, and imposition of environmental compensation of ₹{{FACT:restitution_damages_amount}}/-.
